title: ARED Microgravity Squat & Axial Loading Calibration
sourceRepository: NASA Johnson Space Center · Exercise Countermeasures Lab
summary: Proper harness alignment and bar lock engagement to prevent lumbar shear stress during microgravity axial loading on the Advanced Resistive Exercise Device.
instructions: Verify Main Arm Bar is locked at Station 4 prior to stepping into the footplate.
Tighten waist belt harness snugly below iliac crest; confirm zero vertical play.
Engage vacuum cylinder inertial compensator knob to nominal mission load (140 kg equivalent).
Maintain upright spine posture with eyes fixed on Node 3 bulkhead marker during descent.
Perform 3 sets of 10 repetitions with a controlled 2-second eccentric tempo.

safetyNotices.text: Do not release bar lock until feet are fully flat on the load plates.
Abort exercise if spinal compression pain exceeds mild discomfort; report to Flight Surgeon.

title: Space Motion Sickness (SMS) Vestibular Habituation Protocol
sourceRepository: NASA Human Research Program (HRP) · Neuro-Vestibular Lab
summary: Targeted head-eye coordination drills to accelerate otolith-canal re-weighting and reduce neuro-vestibular disorientation during Flight Days 1-4.
instructions: Anchor feet firmly in handrail restraint to minimize tactile drift.
Fixate gaze on a stationary cabin bulkhead bolt 1.5 meters directly ahead.
Perform gentle ±30° yaw (horizontal) head rotations while holding visual target lock.
Pause for 15 seconds if pallor, diaphoresis, or stomach awareness escalates.
Transition to gentle pitch (vertical) tilts at 0.5 Hz frequency for 2 minutes.

safetyNotices.text: Avoid rapid head pitch movements during translation between ISS modules.
Keep emesis containment bag clipped to flight suit chest ring during first 72 hours.

title: Node 2 Sleep Station Rigging & Cabin Habitability Testing
sourceRepository: ISS Medical Operations & ECLSS Subsystem Team
summary: Tether tensioning, acoustic baffle alignment, and localized CO2 pocket elimination via intake fan duct targeting.
instructions: Verify crew quarter intake fan filter is free of debris; confirm 55 dB acoustic baffle alignment.
Attach four bungee anchor points of sleeping bag to cabin bulkhead clips with 10% tension slack.
Ensure fresh ventilation duct outlet is pointed toward face to prevent local CO2 bubble stagnation.
Position brow strap gently across forehead to prevent involuntary arm drift.
Set cabin ambient lighting spectrum to 450nm-attenuated warm amber 45 minutes prior to sleep.

safetyNotices.text: If waking with throbbing headache or shortness of breath, inspect ventilation duct flow immediately.
Ensure emergency acoustic alarm beacon is unobstructed by personal equipment bags.

title: ISS Operational Science & Clinical Health Maintenance
sourceRepository: NASA Crew Health Care System (CHeCS) · Clinical Care Library
summary: Clinical protocol adherence, daily autonomic telemetry verification, and particulate debris mitigation on station.
instructions: Retrieve Ophthalmic Emergency Kit from Crew Care Bag in Columbus Module.
Seat contoured eye cup firmly against orbital rim; verify seal prevents fluid capillary escape.
Connect syringe suction tube to lower fluid evacuation manifold port.
Instill 15 mL sterile saline through top injection port while blinking continuously.
Inspect eyelid with handheld cobalt blue light and fluorescein strip if scratch sensation persists.

safetyNotices.text: Do not rub eye with gloved or bare fingers; corneal abrasions worsen rapidly in microgravity.
Report any persistent visual acuity degradation or photophobia to Flight Surgeon immediately.

title: Closed-Loop Food Rehydration & Space Galley Nutrition
summary: Septum needle volume dosing for retort food pouches to ensure complete micronutrient, potassium, and fluid reconstitution.
instructions: Inspect foil retort pouch seal for pinhole breaches or vacuum failure.
Insert galley potable water dispenser needle into septum valve until positive detent click.
Select exact water volume (e.g. 150 mL hot at 75°C); depress dispense button once.
Knead pouch thoroughly for 45 seconds to dissolve electrolyte clusters.
Insert into food warmer slot for 15 minutes prior to consumption.

safetyNotices.text: Check septum seal for hot water droplets before undocking needle to avoid skin scalding.
Ensure daily sodium intake remains within Flight Surgeon prescribed limits (<3000 mg/day).

title: Extravehicular Activity (EVA) Spacewalk Protocols
sourceRepository: ESA EAC & NASA Exercise Physiology Team
summary: Motion protocols, tether safety checks, and physical endurance stabilization during microgravity spacewalk sorties.
instructions: Inspect bungee elastomer cords for surface abrasion or fiber fraying.
Attach harness clips to T2 carriage bungee load straps with audible click confirmation.
Step onto belt; verify digital load cells display between 65% and 75% Earth body weight.
Begin with a 3-minute warm-up walk at 4.5 km/h before initiating aerobic running interval.

safetyNotices.text: Always tether emergency stop magnetic clip to waist strap before belt start.
Stop immediately if vibration isolation dampers bottom out against the ISS deck structure.
